other_bash:
cat > song.beat.yaml <<'EOF'
beat: 0.1

meta:
  title: Highway Thunder
  tempo: 126
  time: 4/4
  key: A major
  style: hard rock

instruments:
  dr:  { type: drums }
  bs:  { type: bass }
  gt1: { type: guitar, tone: crunch }
  gt2: { type: guitar, tone: lead }

patterns:
  beat_verse:
    type: drums
    bars: 1
    hits: |
      hh: every 0.5
      sd: 2!acc 4!acc
      bd: 1 3 3.5
  beat_chorus:
    type: drums
    bars: 1
    hits: |
      cr: 1!acc
      rd: every 0.5
      sd: 2!acc 4!acc
      bd: 1 1.5 3 3.5
  fill:
    type: drums
    bars: 1
    hits: |
      sd: 1 1.5 2 2.5
      t1: 3 3.5
      t2: 3.75 4
      t3: 4.5 4.75!acc
      bd: 1 3
  riff:
    type: pitched
    bars: 2
    notes: "A2:8!pm A2!pm A2!pm C3 A2!pm A2!pm D3 C3 | (A2:8!pm)*4 [A2 E3]:4 [A2 E3]:4"
  bass_riff:
    type: pitched
    bars: 2
    notes: "(A1:8)*8 | (A1:8)*6 C2:8 D2:8"
  bass_chorus:
    type: pitched
    bars: 8
    notes: "(A1:8)*8 | (D2:8)*8 | (A1:8)*8 | (E2:8)*8 | (A1:8)*8 | (D2:8)*8 | (E2:8)*8 | (A1:8)*6 E2:8 E2:8"
  verse_gt:
    type: pitched
    bars: 8
    notes: >-
      A2:8!pm A2!pm A2!pm C3 A2!pm A2!pm D3 C3 | (A2:8!pm)*4 [A2 E3]:4 [A2 E3]:4 |
      A2:8!pm A2!pm A2!pm C3 A2!pm A2!pm D3 C3 | (A2:8!pm)*8 |
      (D3:8!pm)*8 | (A2:8!pm)*8 | ([E2 B2]:8!pm)*8 | ([E2 B2]:8!pm)*6 [E2 B2]:4

sections:
  intro:
    bars: 4
    chords: "A5 | A5 | A5 | A5"
    parts:
      gt1: { use: riff }
      bs:
        use: bass_riff
        replace: { 1-2: { notes: "r:1 | r:1" } }
      dr:
        use: beat_verse
        replace:
          1-2: { hits: "hh: 1 2 3 4 | 1 2 3 4" }
          4: { use: fill }

  verse:
    bars: 8
    dynamic: mf
    chords: "A5 | A5 | A5 | A5 | D5 | A5 | E5 | E5"
    parts:
      gt1: { use: verse_gt }
      bs:
        notes: >-
          (A1:8)*8 | (A1:8)*6 C2:8 D2:8 | (A1:8)*8 | (A1:8)*8 |
          (D2:8)*8 | (A1:8)*8 | (E2:8)*8 | (E2:8)*8
      dr:
        use: beat_verse
        replace: { 8: { use: fill } }
        add: { 1: { hits: "cr: 1!acc" } }

  verse2:
    extends: verse
    parts:
      gt2:
        notes: "r:1 | r:1 | r:1 | r:1 | r:1 | r:1 | r:2 [A4 E5]:4 r:4 | r:1"

  chorus:
    bars: 8
    dynamic: f
    chords: "A5 | D5 | A5 | E5 | A5 | D5 | E5 | A5"
    parts:
      gt1:
        notes: >-
          [A2 E3 A3]:4. [A2 E3 A3]:8~ [A2 E3 A3]:2 |
          [D3 A3 D4]:4. [D3 A3 D4]:8~ [D3 A3 D4]:2 |
          [A2 E3 A3]:4. [A2 E3 A3]:8~ [A2 E3 A3]:2 |
          [E2 B2 E3]:4. [E2 B2 E3]:8~ [E2 B2 E3]:2 |
          [A2 E3 A3]:4. [A2 E3 A3]:8~ [A2 E3 A3]:2 |
          [D3 A3 D4]:4. [D3 A3 D4]:8~ [D3 A3 D4]:2 |
          [E2 B2 E3]:4. [E2 B2 E3]:8~ [E2 B2 E3]:2 |
          [A2 E3 A3]:2 [A2 E3 A3]:4 r:4
      bs: { use: bass_chorus }
      dr:
        use: beat_chorus
        replace: { 8: { use: fill } }

  chorus_last:
    extends: chorus
    parts:
      gt2:
        notes: >-
          E5:4. C5:8 A4:4 C5:4 |
          E5:2~ E5:4!vib D5:8 C5:8 |
          A4:4 C5:8 D5:8 E5:4 G5:4 |
          A5:2~ A5:4!vib r:4 |
          r:4 E5:8 G5:8 A5:4 G5:4 |
          E5:4. D5:8 C5:4 D5:4 |
          B4:8 D5:8 E5:4 G5:4 B5:4 |
          A5:2~ A5:2!fall

  outro:
    bars: 2
    dynamic: ff
    chords: "A5 | A5"
    parts:
      gt1: { notes: "[A2 E3 A3 C#4]:1~ | [A2 E3 A3 C#4]:1" }
      bs: { notes: "A1:1~ | A1:1" }
      dr:
        hits: |
          cr: 1!acc |
          bd: 1!acc |

form: [intro, verse, chorus, verse2, chorus_last, outro]

performance:
  seed: 11
  humanize: { timing_ms: 5, velocity: 0.04 }
  parts:
    bs: { offset_ms: 3 }

mix:
  space: studio
  gt1: { gain_db: -2, pan: -0.4 }
  gt2: { gain_db: -3, pan: 0.4, reverb: more }
  master: { style: rock, loudness: -14 }
EOF
beat validate song.beat.yaml; beat events song.beat.yaml --by-bar --bars 1-6 | head -30
denied:
Bash: cat > song.beat.yaml <<'EOF'
beat: 0.1

meta:
  title: Highway Thunder
  tempo: 126
  time: 4/4
  key: A major
  style: hard rock

instruments:
  dr:  { type: drums }
  bs:  { type: bass }
  gt1
notes:
# Notes

## 1. Hard or confusing
- SPEC.md is written in Chinese, and it is long (33 KB). My first read of it was truncated by tool output limits.
- It is unclear whether `chords:` has to match the `notes`. It seems to be used only for analysis.
- Rules such as "no more than 2 hands at once" and "a note can't cross a bar line" only show up when you validate.
- A `hits` bar needs every lane to have the same number of bars, and the `|` syntax for that is easy to forget.
- A Bash call was denied partway through the session, so I couldn't chain the write, validate and events commands in one call.
- I did not run `beat events`, so the bar-by-bar check of rhythms was skipped. `beat validate` passed: 38 bars, 0 warnings.

## 2. Workarounds
- I used `extends` to make `chorus_last` (the lead-guitar chorus) and `verse2`. This avoids copying the rhythm parts.
- The 8-bar rhythm-guitar verse is one pattern (`verse_gt`), because `replace` can't change a pattern's pitch for only some bars.
- The bass chorus line is a pattern so that both choruses share it.
- Only the last chorus has a `!fall` ending, so the last chorus has a different shape from the first.

## 3. Wishes
- A `chords:`-to-bass auto-fill, such as a root-eighths shortcut like `bass: roots 8`.
- A power-chord shorthand, e.g. `A5` expanding to a playable voicing in the guitar's range.
- A warning when a lead part is written but sits below the rhythm guitar's top note.
- An English version of the spec.
